key_insight: No single entropy captures all quantum-information properties; complementary measures reveal different physical and operational limits.
engineering_relevance: Choosing an entropy suited to the task can help characterize limits in quantum communication, cryptography, and thermodynamic resource use.
method: Motivate entropy definitions through natural physical principles.
Survey Rényi and smooth entropies and their interrelations.
Connect measures to communication, cryptography, resource theories, thermodynamics, and many-body physics.
evidence_signal: The abstract describes a structured theoretical review, not new experimental data or numerical benchmarks.
watch_item: The review does not establish a universally applicable entropy; practical use requires matching each measure to the relevant setting and assumptions.
